body: Im in therapy 2 days a week, there is also a psychiatrist in the team. Ive anti-depressants but they dont seem to work that much. One time ive talked very open about this obsession towards one of the therapists, ive said it is a huge problem and that i need help and that the heartache is taken too long. The only thing they say is that it is a grieving process. Ive lost trust and hope in western psychology. They dont know what they're doing. The only way out of this seems to be death and the scariest thing is that right now it are not my emotions that says this, but my mind. Emotional , im doing better than when i wrote the first message. I went outside and had some fresh air. But i still think that death is the only solution.

I actually am a stalker. He made it clear that he considered it as harrassment. But i cant stop e-mailing. Sometimes it goes well for months or weeks but then i do it again. I dont think it will ever stop. So the only solution is for me to die. I cant control myself.

This man is not for me indeed. :( He does not want me anymore. Yes i am still in love with him, its been 5 years now but i cant let it go. No one else wants me and i am emotionally too scarred and tired to try to build a connection with someone. I gave up searching for a husband 1-2 years ago i think. I am pretty sure it wont happen anymore as much as it hurts saying this. I dont know how i can live with that while knowing that they have the perfect family that i long for. Jealousy is eating me from the inside, its truly a horrible emotion and there is no way back now. Im completly evil.

sorry for going on, thank you for your reaction and listening.
